def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0, 5)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] not in (0, 5)]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h], [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = [[ [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1])
                           for c in range(cb[j]+1,cb[j+1])]
                for j in range(len(cb)-1)] for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    # The repeated non-separator color is the panel background; repeated
    # isolated marks are encoded as 1 in the output summary.
    from collections import Counter
    vals = [v for row in panels for panel in row for v in panel]
    base = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for row in panels:
        outrow=[]
        for panel in row:
            outrow.append(1 if sum(v != base for v in panel) > 1 else base)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
PY
